correctness.rationale: On the exact slice xdot=r(y-x), zdot=gmx²-g(1+m)xy, so H=z+g(1+m)x²/(2r) has Hdot=-gx². For bounded forward orbit H is bounded below and decreasing; x∈L², xdot bounded, so x->0. Then z->H∞ and omega-limit invariance forces x=0 -> y=0 -> v=0 -> u=0, hence convergence to the single equilibrium (0,0,H∞,0,0). A compactly supported invariant measure obeys 0=∫LH=-g∫x² and support invariance yields exactly the same equilibrium line. Independently reconstructed the exact 5x5 source-parameter Jacobian over rational numbers; charpoly λ²(10λ³+82λ²+61λ+6100)/10 and roots -11.95668, 1.87834±6.89125i. These rates describe transverse variational instability, not a moving orbit from the exact stationary origin.
